en.today: Challenges greet you this morning, dearest Aries, as the Libra Sun and Saturn face off. Be mindful of your responsibilities to others, yourself, and the upcoming work week. Though you might prefer a day of leisure, it will be hard to relax if you don't deal with important matters. As the Cancer Moon squares Chiron before entering Leo, you're asked to recharge without spending too much time at rest. You'll feel lighter and energized while Luna aspects Neptune, Pluto, and Mars throughout the evening. Conflict with peers or excessive screen usage could set you back, but creative outlets will boost stamina.

en.today: Dreams without structure will fade into the wind, dearest Leo, as the Libra Moon and Saturn face off. Sift through any goals you've been entertaining to determine which ones are the most attainable. Try not to mourn what you set aside while the Cancer Moon squares Chiron this afternoon. Prioritizing realistic agendas can help you eventually reach bigger aspirations later on. Luna debuts in your sign just before evening creeps in, revealing silver linings where you once saw dark clouds. Aspects with Neptune, Pluto, and Mars will sharpen the imagination, build motivation, and remind you of your support system.

en.today: Stay strong in your convictions while the Libra Sun opposes Saturn, dear bull. Temptations will be prevalent, but probably don't align with what is best for you. Vices you recently gave up will be especially hard to resist. Maintain resolve when the Cancer Moon squares Chiron before entering Leo later today. You might start rationalizing reasons to give in, but you'll feel better about yourself for exercising restraint. Confidence grows when you prioritize growth and making your way up in the world. Meditate on how you can continue to evolve once Luna aspects Neptune, Pluto, and Mars this evening.

en.today: The Libra Moon and Saturn form a challenging opposition, which may cause you to wonder who your real friends are. Being overlooked for opportunities or left out of social events will feel like an ego hit and put you in a defensive headspace. Though you'll want others to know their actions hurt, guilt trips or subdued behavior won't land well when the Cancer Moon squares Chiron. Pick yourself up and try to mend rifts once Luna debuts in Leo. Aspects with Neptune, Pluto, and Mars indicate you might still gain traction with influential peers who can lift you.
